# Sign on the Line Notary

> Mobile notary public based in Glendale, California, serving Glendale, Burbank,
> Pasadena, and the greater Los Angeles area. Steve Davis, California Commissioned
> Notary Public, bonded and insured, comes to the client's home, office, hospital,
> or care facility. Trust and estate document signings are a specialty
> (Certified Notary Trust Delivery Agent, CNTDA).

## What we do
- Acknowledgments, jurats, oaths and affirmations
- Living trust and estate planning packages: trusts, certifications of trust, financial powers of attorney, advance health care directives, trust transfer deeds
- Powers of attorney, affidavits, grant deeds, quitclaim deeds
- Certified copies of powers of attorney
- Hospital, nursing home, and care facility signings
- Can serve as one of the two witnesses on a California will (wills are witnessed, not notarized, in California)

## What we do not do
- Loan signings or mortgage closings
- Legal advice or help choosing or drafting documents
- Certified copies of vital records (birth, death, marriage); those come from the issuing agency
- Form I-9 employment verification (prohibited for California notaries)

## Pricing (through December 31, 2026)
- $15 per notarized signature, the California statutory maximum. Rises to $20 on January 1, 2027.
- Flat travel fee by zone: Zone 1 $45, Zone 2 $60, Zone 3 $75, Zone 4 by quote
- Surcharges: after-hours +$35, same-day rush +$35, hospital or care facility +$25
- Full schedule: https://signontheline.net/pricing.html

## Where we work
- Zone 1: Glendale, Burbank, La Canada Flintridge, La Crescenta, Montrose, Verdugo City, Tujunga, Sunland, Altadena
- Zone 2: Pasadena, South Pasadena, San Marino, Sierra Madre, Arcadia, Monrovia, Eagle Rock, Highland Park, Glassell Park, Mount Washington, Cypress Park, North Hollywood, Valley Village, Studio City, Toluca Lake
- Zone 3: Sherman Oaks, Van Nuys, Northridge, Alhambra, Temple City, Los Feliz, Atwater Village, Silver Lake, Echo Park, Lincoln Heights, Downtown Los Angeles

## Hours
By appointment, 7 days a week, 9am to 9pm. Standard rate Monday through Saturday 9am to 7pm. Same-day appointments with at least 2 hours notice.
